preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(3 <= N <= 10**3 for N in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length of the array N is between 3 and 1000 inclusive.
The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 5000.

postconditions.expression: all(len(A) == N for N, A in zip(test_cases, output_arrays))
postconditions.description: Each output array A has the same length N as its corresponding test case.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= x <= 10**18 for x in A) for A in output_arrays)
postconditions.description: Each element x in each output array A is between 1 and 10^18 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(all(any(gcd(*S) == i for S in combinations(A, k)) for i in range(1, N+1)) for N, A in zip(test_cases, output_arrays))
postconditions.description: For each test case, for all 1 ≤ i ≤ N, there exists a subsequence S of length k (2 ≤ k ≤ N) in the output array A such that gcd(S) = i.
